paper_title: PELMS Pre-training for Effective Low-Shot Multi-Document Summarization
caption: Low-shot pre-trained model performance on the multi-document summarization (MDS) task with ROUGE-G scores (geometric mean of ROUGE-1/2/L) aggregated over 6 MDS benchmarks. We compare with fully-supervised training (solid lines) and with adapter training (dashed lines) where only 5% of model parameters are tuned. achieves stronger overall performance at all data quantities and training methods when compared to competitive long-input summarization models.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of several models on a multi-document summarization task, represented by ROUGE-G scores. The x-axis is labeled "# Training Examples" and spans from 0 to 64, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 16. The y-axis is labeled "Overall ROUGE-G Score" and ranges from approximately 11.0 to 19.0, using a linear scale. A blue, dashed line, labeled "PELMS," begins at a value of around 13.0 at x=0 and increases to approximately 17.0 at x=64. An orange, dashed line, labeled "Pegasus-X (5%)", begins at approximately 13.8 at x=0 and reaches approximately 17.5 at x=64. A green, solid line, labeled "PELMS," starts at roughly 13.8 at x=0 and rises to approximately 19.0 at x=64. A yellow, solid line, labeled "Prima" begins at roughly 14.7 at x=0 and increases to approximately 17.7 at x=64. An orange dashed line, labeled "Prima (5%)", begins at approximately 14.7 at x=0 and rises to approximately 17.8 at x=64. A yellow, dashed line, labeled “Centrum (5%)”, starts at approximately 15.0 at x=0 and climbs to roughly 17.9 at x=64.
